_meta.note: Generated automatically — every edge starts OPEN/GOOD. Road status and condition updates come from the CDRRMO admin workflow, not this script. Only the largest connected component is kept, so isolated fragments clipped by the bounding box are excluded.
_meta.onewayNote: Original OSM way direction and access tags are preserved. The router enforces access and one-way rules per travel mode. Turn-restriction relations are not included.
_meta.cityCoverageNote: Original network preserved; newly mapped road IDs entirely inside the operational Santa Rosa boundary were added from a full-city OSM extract.
